theorems.name: Submission.codim1_lur_det_covector_clm
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (A : Euclid P →L[ℝ] Euclid (n + 1)), ∃ Λ : Euclid (n + 1) →L[ℝ] Covector (Euclid P) n, ∀ (p : Euclid (n + 1)) (a : Fin n → Euclid P), Λ p a = Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun r c : Fin (n + 1) => (Fin.cons p (fun k : Fin n => A (a k)) : Fin (n + 1) → Euclid (n + 1)) c r)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
